events.headline: Brent crude hits five-month high near $112/bbl on Houthi attacks on Saudi infrastructure and a Gulf tanker strike, before easing to ~$108.79 as markets weigh a possible US waiver on Russian energy sanctions
Putin proposes three-way Ukraine summit with Trump and Xi, excluding Zelenskyy, as Russian strikes hit Ukrainian energy infrastructure overnight, leaving roughly 550,000 households without power
ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent place over $35B in orders for Nvidia's new export-compliant RTX PRO 5500 GPU, though Nvidia warns it cannot fill full demand due to production constraints
